      "quote": "The miner currently does not enforce the murch-zawy rule but I think it should.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "addressed by merged PR #35949 and rebase",

      "status_by_quote": "Rebased now that #35949 is merged."

      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Lax mempools could generate invalid block templates across the activation boundary",
      "quote": "in fact it's a dumb nuisance attack vector for the few transition blocks during activation if the miners are running \"lax\" mempools.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer accepted explanation that non-standard rule enforcement and mempool sanity checks mitigate risk",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3759449784"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3974207397",
      "status_by_quote": "Okay if `-acceptnonstdtxs` effect starts to kickoff as short as there is a release including this code, I think this is"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3842747883",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Categorizing BIP54 check failures as TX_CONSENSUS before activation misrepresents policy rejections",
      "quote": "This signals the state as TX_CONSENSUS even if this is a policy check. Does not affect in debug/log messages or the rejected reason message, but feels weird to miss-categorize it.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained rationale in commit message and noted divergence from Inquisition is not worthwhile",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3994152368", "rc:4000776088"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4000776088",
      "status_by_quote": "Sure. I gave the rationale for this decision in the commit message though, because i could not find a satisfactory place"
    },
    {

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Define what is understood as legacy signature ops in consensus.h",
      "quote": "there could be a definition of what is understood as a \"legacy signature ops\" even if it's just echoing the bip doc",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agreed to replace with \"non-Segwit signature operations\"",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3693155035"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3693155035",
      "status_by_quote": "Ok, i can replace with \"non-Segwit signature operations\"."
    },
    {

      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "What is the rationale for the asymmetry in legacy signature accounting for CHECKMULTISIG?",
      "quote": "curious if there is any rational somewhere in all the design notes, that's explaining that choice for the asymmetry in the legacy signature accounting for `CHECKMULTISIG`",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained it reuses BIP 16 accounting to avoid adding another opcode counting method",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3716288610", "rc:3752345779"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3716288610",
      "status_by_quote": "the rationale is to reuse BIP 16 accounting, instead of introducing another opcode counting method in consensus rules."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3732075425",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Should the BIP text or code clarify that difficulty adjustment period constants derive from network adjustment period?",
      "quote": "could we adjust the BIP text, or add a note here to clarify that these values are derived from the network's adjustment period rather than fixed constants?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained code already uses network params and BIP text should optimize for mainnet clarity",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3752511384", "rc:3994039945"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3994039945",
      "status_by_quote": "I think the BIP should always optimize to be maximally clear for mainnet."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3739690020",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Add functional test case for transaction with 2501 sigops to verify boundary check",
      "quote": "there could be a test for the case where the tx has `2501 sigops` and as such is invalid per BIP54 new rule.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained sigops bounds checking is already extensively covered in unit tests",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3752747383"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3752747383",
      "status_by_quote": "Bound checking for sigops accounting is tested extensively in unit tests"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3739713347",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Check that fuzz harness covers nested control flow scripts to exercise consensus sigops parser",
      "quote": "i would check the test before if it's covered though getting tortuous and valid control flow redeemScript with 10-depth OP_IF then the OP_CHECKSIG",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that fuzz guidance improvements for stateful logic are orthogonal to this PR",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3994085442"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3994085442",
      "status_by_quote": "What are you suggesting doing here? I agree code coverage guidance is sometimes lacking when fuzzing stateful logic."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3974075397",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Adjust consensus description comment to specify rule is only applied to testnet4",
      "quote": "I think the description comment can be adjusted above to say it's only applied to testnet4 and not to signet, regtest, testnet3",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained constant name already has TESTNET4 suffix and cites BIP 94",

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4000656679",
      "status_by_quote": "The constant was renamed with a TESTNET4 a suffix with the purpose of making it clear it's only used for testnet4."
    },

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Define comment mathematically to clarify whether equality is included in timewarp check",
      "quote": "the comment could be \"strictly inferior\" which is more defined mathematically than \"must not be more than 2 hours\"",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated comment to positive phrasing using \"superior or equal\"",

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4000703070",
      "status_by_quote": "fair enough, i updated the comment to use \"superior or equal\" language"
    },

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Update BLOCK_INVALID_HEADER comment in validation.h to include time too old",
      "quote": "`BLOCK_INVALID_HEADER` comment in `src/consensus/validation.h` could be updated to include \"invalid proof of work or time too old\".",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author pointed out validation.h already contains this note",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4000716827"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4000716827",
      "status_by_quote": "This is already what the comment says"
    },

      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Are there potential edge case issues or missing test coverage for caches and mempool reorg under the new consensus rules?",
